description: Camoufox hooks - redirect WebSearch/WebFetch to camoufox CLI browser automation

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"## Camoufox Browser CLI Available

The `camoufox` CLI provides real browser automation via Camoufox anti-detect browser. Use it instead of `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` for better results — it handles JS-heavy pages, authenticated sessions, and works globally (not US-only).

### Quick workflow (via Bash tool)
```bash
# 1. Ensure daemon is running
camoufox ping --json || camoufox serve --foreground &

# 2. Launch browser
camoufox launch --json
# Returns: instance_id

# 3. Create a page
camoufox new-page <instance_id> --json
# Returns: page_id

# 4. Navigate
camoufox navigate <instance_id> <page_id> <url> --json

# 5. Extract text content
camoufox evaluate <instance_id> <page_id> 'document.body.innerText' --json

# 6. Take screenshot
camoufox screenshot <instance_id> <page_id> --json
```

### Other commands
- `camoufox list --json` — list running instances
- `camoufox stop <instance_id> --json` — stop an instance
- `camoufox shutdown --json` — stop daemon + all instances

Always use `--json` flag for machine-readable output."}}
EOF
